title: Investigate intermittent checkout failures before scoping a fix
body: Customers occasionally report checkout failing, but we have no reliable repro and no root cause yet. We need to dig in and gather facts before we can write a real plan.

title: Integrate the quux analytics client
body: Wire up the new analytics vendor: add quux_client.py and call quux_connect() during app boot, configured from quux.yaml. None of these exist in the repo yet.

title: Harden the tick-mutex warning message
body: Improve the warning emitted by the lock fallback in scripts/lib/common.sh when flock is missing, so operators clearly see the missing tool name.

title: Maybe rethink the whole onboarding thing?
body: Not sure exactly what we want here. The onboarding feels off somehow. Could use some thinking about the overall direction.
